description: This Java abstract class defines a base validator for command sizes in the Eclipse Ditto project, providing methods to enforce size constraints and throwing appropriate exceptions when limits are exceeded.

classes.name: AbstractCommandSizeValidator
classes.description: An abstract class responsible for validating the size of commands and throwing a specific exception when size constraints are violated.

methods.name: AbstractCommandSizeValidator
methods.description: Constructor that sets the maximum allowed size for commands.

methods.name: getMaxSize
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the maximum size limit if set.

methods.name: ensureValidSize
methods.description: Checks if the size provided by sizeSupplier exceeds the maxSize and throws an exception if it does.

methods.name: ensureValidSize (overloaded)
methods.description: Checks size based on an upper bound supplier, invoking the size check only if the upper bound exceeds the maxSize.

methods.name: newInvalidSizeException
methods.description: Abstract method to create an exception when size exceeds the limit, to be implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: getMaxSize
methods.description: Returns an Optional of the maximum size.

methods.name: ensureValidSize
methods.description: Validates the size using a LongSupplier, throws exception if exceeded.

methods.name: ensureValidSize (overloaded)
methods.description: Validates size with an upper bound supplier, throws if upper bound exceeds limit.

methods.name: newInvalidSizeException
methods.description: Creates a custom exception for size violations; implementation provided in subclasses.
